title: Casper
overview:
Use your ghostly skills to solve over 20 complex puzzles, find secret passageways, hidden clues and locate pieces of the dismantled Lazarus Machine in order to bring Casper back to life.

Based on the hit movie, including some of the same great 3D animation and hilarious gags.

Wage a battle of wits with the ghostly trio: Stretch, Stinkie and Fatso as they harass, torment, chase and trick you.

Morph into and out of a host of humorous objects, float through walls and power sockets.
